name: digital-decibels
description: Digital Decibels plugins for client project work.

plugins.name: client-docs
plugins.description: Creates, audits and maintains client handoff documentation. Detects the project's stack rather than assuming one. Dormant until /docs-init is run.

plugins.name: drupal-scaffold
plugins.description: Builds Drupal configuration with idempotent PHP scripts instead of by clicking. Ships the portable half of a real Drupal 11 build, plus the config export and import traps that make it safe to run.
